{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABcrl0tQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhGNt9c", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 221, "title": "Simplify Live Display tabs: remove duplicate pane headings and Copy text buttons", "body": "## Goal

Simplify the Chrome extension Live view so each Display input tab is primarily a reading surface. **Remove both the redundant title/heading inside each tab's content panel and the per-panel `Copy text` button**.

The tab strip already labels each selectable input (e.g. "Transcript", "Translation", "Summary"), so repeating that label as a large heading inside the panel wastes vertical space. The prominent Copy text button is not needed in the normal Live workflow and should be removed rather than simply moved elsewhere.

## Intended UI

Current layout (within each Display):

```text
[ Transcript ] [ Translation ] [ Summary ]  ← tabs from Display input ports

Transcript                            [Copy text]  ← remove this entire row
------------------------------------------------
(transcript content)
```

Desired:

```text
[ Transcript ] [ Translation ] [ Summary ]
------------------------------------------------
(transcript content begins immediately here)
```

This is strictly a presentation cleanup. **Do not change the mapping introduced in #216: one Display node has independently updating input ports, and each input port is a switchable tab.** Do not turn the input tabs into columns or map tabs to separate Display nodes.

## Required changes

- Remove the visible per-pane `<h2 class="display-label">` title and its associated header row from each Live text pane. The tab button remains the visible label for that content.
- Remove the per-pane `Copy text` button and its clipboard-handler / success-or-error notice UI (e.g. "Text copied." and the clipboard failure notice). No replacement icon, overflow menu, toolbar control or new clipboard interaction is required in this task. Native browser text selection/copy should remain usable.
- Preserve per-input tab labels/settings, active-tab styles, ARIA tab/tabpanel association, meaningful accessible names, keyboard/touch switching, focus behavior and the special single-input presentation (which may have no visible tab strip).
- Preserve independent snapshot updates, hidden-tab updates, safe TEXT/ITEM rendering, last snapshot, per-pane scrolling, scroll-follow intent, focus/selection behavior and Stop/Cancel/Restart behavior.
- The simplified pane should not retain unnecessary top padding, blank status rows or empty header spacing. Content should use the freed vertical room effectively at desktop and narrow/mobile Live widths.
- Update DOM operations that currently assume a pane has a `button` or `.display-label`, including `labelPane()`, `mountSnapshot()`, and any pane creation code; avoid null dereferences on rendering, label changes, empty snapshots or tab switching.
- Any copy-control tests or documentation should be updated to reflect that this feature is intentionally absent; do not delete unrelated tab-switching/scroll/accessibility coverage.

## Likely files

- `extension/live-text-regions.js` (currently creates pane heading, Copy text button, notice, and assumes they exist in `labelPane`/`mountSnapshot`)
- `extension/recorder.css` (header/heading spacing)
- `tests/extension/display-tabs.spec.js` and `tests/fixtures/display-tabs.js` (tab and copy-control assertions)
- Related Live UX help / documentation as appropriate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With `Display.input1`, `input2`, `input3` configured as separate tabs, the selected panel shows **only content** below the tab strip: no repeated title, no "Copy text" control, no empty copy-status region.
- [ ] The tab strip still shows meaningful user-configured input labels and activates the correct panel.
- [ ] A single-input Display is also free of the per-pane title and copy UI while retaining a meaningful accessible label.
- [ ] Data updates to active and hidden tabs render correctly without exceptions or lost scroll state; updates with empty snapshots and runtime label changes are safe.
- [ ] Native text selection and keyboard navigation remain usable.
- [ ] Responsive layout has no leftover vertical gap corresponding to the removed header.
- [ ] Regression/unit/MV3 browser tests are adjusted and run; explicitly verify removed controls and the continuing input-tab behavior from #216.

## Scope

UI simplification only. Do not modify graph schema, node/port types, runtime computation, Graph Actions buttons (#219), or Display tab identity/persistence.
